about: The likeness checklist (likeness_guide.md). Items in artists' order, big to small. Point numbers are MediaPipe Face Landmarker's 478 (the same detector reads the photo and a clay render of the model through the photo's fitted camera); points in the 68-point table (likeness.MP68) fall back to the model's own landmarks when no detector is available. Axes are the FACE's in the picture: x across (towards the subject's left), y down the midline (nasion 168 -> menton 152). mm at the face's depth through the camera. 'pairs' = the subject's right and left, averaged. Tilts: degrees, + = the outer / second point higher.

stages.name: proportions
stages.what: head and face size, the face's thirds, where the eyes sit in the face

stages.name: widths
stages.what: face widths level by level, the outline (temple, cheekbone, jaw angle, chin)

stages.name: structure
stages.what: the planes and hollows (cheekbone, temple and jaw corners, cheek hollow, folds, under-eye, brow ridge) and the jaw's L (ramus, angle, lower border, neck)
stages.control: shape.hollow / shape.planes / shape.jaw_angle / features.brow_ridge (1-D fits on the shading)

stages.name: eyes
stages.what: spacing, size, tilt, lid opening, hooding

stages.name: brows
stages.what: height over the eyes, arch, tail, thickness

stages.name: nose
stages.what: length, alar width, tip, bridge, profile

stages.name: chin_jaw
stages.what: chin height and width, jaw angle

descriptors_about: The character read (likeness_guide.md, stage 0): gestalt descriptors as artists, casting and forensic class descriptors use them, each bound to bands on checklist items in every view, seen or not. Bands are FIRST VALUES in the item's own unit (1e9 = open), to be calibrated on real heads.

descriptors.name: lean
descriptors.what: Bone shows: hollows under the cheekbones, a clear jaw line, little under the chin.

descriptors.name: chunky
descriptors.what: Broad and solid, not fat: a wide lower face on a thick neck, cheeks full but the jaw still reads.

descriptors.name: heavy
descriptors.what: Soft and full: jowls, the jaw line lost into the neck.

descriptors.name: square
descriptors.what: As wide at the jaw as at the cheekbones, about as high as wide; corners at the jaw.

descriptors.name: long (oblong)
descriptors.what: Clearly higher than wide, straight sides.

descriptors.name: round
descriptors.what: As wide as high, no corners: full cheeks, soft jaw.

descriptors.name: heart / triangular
descriptors.what: Wide at the cheekbones and temples, tapering to a narrow jaw and chin.

descriptors.name: diamond
descriptors.what: Widest at the cheekbones; narrow temples and a narrow jaw.

descriptors.name: square jaw
descriptors.what: A visible corner under the ear: near-vertical ramus, a flat lower border, the neck stepping in under it. Shows in every view.

descriptors.name: soft jaw
descriptors.what: No corner: one curve from ear to chin, the border lost into the neck.

descriptors.name: narrow jaw
descriptors.what: The jaw well inside the cheekbones' width.

descriptors.name: lantern jaw
descriptors.what: A long heavy jaw: deep chin, a strong corner set low.

descriptors.name: strong chin
descriptors.what: The chin's front stands out to (or past) the lips' line in profile; a clear corner under it.

descriptors.name: weak / receding chin
descriptors.what: The chin falls back under the lips in profile.

descriptors.name: broad / square chin
descriptors.what: A wide flat chin front, two corners.

descriptors.name: pointed chin
descriptors.what: A narrow chin coming to a point.

descriptors.name: cleft chin
descriptors.what: A vertical groove or dimple on the chin's midline.
descriptors.control: shape.chin.cleft (m deep; by hand: no item measures a groove yet, judge the six-view sheet)

descriptors.name: straight nose
descriptors.what: A straight bridge from nasion to tip in profile.

descriptors.name: aquiline / hooked
descriptors.what: A convex bridge; the tip turned down, the base line hanging.

descriptors.name: snub / upturned (cute)
descriptors.what: Short; the base line rises to a blunt tip, the nostrils and columella show; a straight or scooped bridge.

descriptors.name: bulbous tip
descriptors.what: A big round tip, wider than the bridge.

descriptors.name: broad nose
descriptors.what: Wide wings and a wide bridge.

descriptors.name: button nose
descriptors.what: Small, short and round.

descriptors.name: heavy brow
descriptors.what: A brow ridge that overhangs the eyes; low thick brows.

descriptors.name: flat brow
descriptors.what: No ridge: the forehead runs straight into the eye sockets.

descriptors.name: deep-set eyes
descriptors.what: Eyes back under the brow, in shadow.

descriptors.name: hooded eyes
descriptors.what: The fold over the upper lid hides the lid (NOT a squint: check the expression first).

descriptors.name: wide / open eyes
descriptors.what: Tall eye openings, the lid showing.

descriptors.name: gaunt cheeks
descriptors.what: A hollow under each cheekbone.

descriptors.name: full cheeks
descriptors.what: Round cheeks; the far cheek's line runs straight down past the mouth in three-quarter.

descriptors.name: rugged
descriptors.what: Strong planes, heavy brow, a square jaw, lines; nothing soft.
descriptors.control: the sum of: jaw_square, brow_heavy, lines (skin)

descriptors.name: boyish
descriptors.what: Soft planes, a short nose, full cheeks, a small chin.
descriptors.control: the sum of: nose_snub, cheeks_full, jaw_soft

items.name: Face height (nasion to chin)
items.look: From the bridge of the nose between the eyes down to the bottom of the chin: is the face long or short for its width?

items.name: Face index (height / cheekbone width)
items.look: The face's overall shape: long and narrow, or broad and short. Compare height (nasion to chin) with width at the cheekbones.

items.name: Middle third (nasion to subnasale)
items.look: The nose's share of the face: nasion to where the nose meets the lip.

items.name: Lower third (subnasale to chin)
items.look: Mouth and chin together: from under the nose to the bottom of the chin. Long lower faces read older and heavier.

items.name: Lower third / middle third
items.look: The balance of nose and jaw: artists' first check of a face's proportions (about 1.0 in an adult; more = a long jaw).

items.name: Mouth line (share of eyes-to-chin)
items.look: Where the lips meet, as a share of the way from the eye corners down to the chin: artists' check that the mouth sits about a third of the way down the lower face.

items.name: Forehead height (hairline to brow)
items.look: Hairline to the brow line. The clay model has no hair: judge against the hair model, not the bald clay; the detector's top points are guesses on a bald head.
items.reliability: unmeasurable: hairline is hair, not landmarks

items.name: Forehead slope
items.look: From the side: the forehead upright or sloping back from the brow ridge.
items.reliability: profile item: judge by eye

items.name: Width at the temples
items.look: Width across the temples, just above the brow tails, where the skull narrows (hair often hides it).

items.name: Width at the cheekbones (bizygomatic)
items.look: The widest part of the face, across the cheekbones at the level of the lower lids: the most identity-bearing width.

items.name: Face width at the nose base
items.look: Face width at the level of the nostrils: the mid-cheek, where fullness or hollows show in the outline.

items.name: Face width at the mouth
items.look: Face width at the mouth's corners: the masseters and lower cheeks.

items.name: Width at the jaw angles (bigonial)
items.look: Width across the jaw's angles below the ears: a square or tapering lower face. The detector's jaw contour is a guess where the jaw meets the neck; compare it on both sides the same way.
items.reliability: medium: the jaw contour is the detector's guess on both sides

items.name: Chin width
items.look: Width of the chin's front, between the corners where the jaw line turns forward.

items.name: Jaw width / cheekbone width
items.look: The face's taper from cheekbones to jaw: heart-shaped, oval or square.

items.name: Temple plane (front-to-side turn)
items.look: Where the forehead's front turns into the side of the head at the temple: a crisp plane change or a round dome.
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it

items.name: Cheekbone plane (front-to-side turn)
items.look: The cheekbone's corner: where the front of the cheek turns to the side. Lean, structured faces turn it sharply.
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it

items.name: Jaw plane (front-to-side turn at the jaw)
items.look: Where the lower face's front turns to the side over the jaw: a square jaw shows a side plane in shadow.
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it

items.name: Cheek hollow under the cheekbone
items.look: The hollow between cheekbone and jaw: lean faces show a shadowed dip, full faces a smooth convex cheek.
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it

items.name: Nasolabial fold depth
items.look: The fold from the nose's wing down past the mouth's corner: how deep and how far it runs.
items.control: GAP: no fold control (a crease stroke or push by hand)
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it

items.name: Under-eye hollow (tear trough)
items.look: Below the lower lid, before the cheek: a hollow or a smooth slope into the cheek.
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it

items.name: Brow ridge projection
items.look: How far the brow stands out over the eye: a strong ridge shadows the socket and the upper lid.
items.reliability: shading: the photo against the model lit like it (likeness_shape); albedo (stubble, paint) and a painter's light confound it; the brows' hair is beside the region

items.name: Ramus angle from vertical
items.look: The back edge of the jaw from under the ear down to the angle: near vertical (an L) or leaning (one diagonal line ear to chin).
items.control: GAP: no ramus control (shape.jaw_angle moves the angle only)
items.reliability: a trace on the reference (likeness_points: jaw.R / jaw.L, ear_lobe, neck) against the model's own jaw contour (depth edge in its render) found along it

items.name: Gonial angle (the jaw's corner)
items.look: The angle between the ramus and the lower border: ~115-125 deg in a strong male jaw; obtuse (140+) reads soft.
items.reliability: a trace on the reference (likeness_points: jaw.R / jaw.L, ear_lobe, neck) against the model's own jaw contour (depth edge in its render) found along it

items.name: Lower border straightness
items.look: The jaw's lower edge from the angle forward to the chin: a crisp straight border or a sagging curve.
items.reliability: a trace on the reference (likeness_points: jaw.R / jaw.L, ear_lobe, neck) against the model's own jaw contour (depth edge in its render) found along it

items.name: Jaw angle below the ear lobe
items.look: How far below the ear lobe the jaw's corner sits.
items.reliability: a trace on the reference (likeness_points: jaw.R / jaw.L, ear_lobe, neck) against the model's own jaw contour (depth edge in its render) found along it

items.name: Jaw angle against the mouth line
items.look: The jaw's corner against the line of the mouth: level with it or well below.
items.reliability: a trace on the reference (likeness_points: jaw.R / jaw.L, ear_lobe, neck) against the model's own jaw contour (depth edge in its render) found along it

items.name: Neck stepping in under the jaw
items.look: How far the neck's contour sits in from the jaw's lower border: a clear step, or jaw and neck one line.
items.control: GAP: body (neck) / jaw shape by hand
items.reliability: a trace on the reference (likeness_points: jaw.R / jaw.L, ear_lobe, neck) against the model's own jaw contour (depth edge in its render) found along it

items.name: Forehead slope (contour)
items.look: The far-side contour above the brow: upright, or sloping back going up.
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Brow ridge over the orbit (contour)
items.look: The contour's step from the brow's peak in to the orbit under it: a heavy overhanging brow or a flat one.
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Cheek line at the mouth's height (contour)
items.look: How far the far cheek's line at the mouth's height stands in from the brow's peak: a lean face falls in, a full one runs straight down.
items.control: shape.hollow / fit_outline on the profile contour
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Eye spacing (between the irises)
items.look: Distance between the eyes' centres. On the photo the irises, on the render the painted iris discs: same detector, same definition.

items.name: Inner eye corners apart (intercanthal)
items.look: The gap between the inner eye corners, over the bridge of the nose; about one eye's width in most faces.

items.name: Eye width (palpebral fissure length)
items.look: Inner corner to outer corner of each eye.

items.name: Canthal tilt (eye rotation)
items.look: The slant of each eye: the outer corner above or below the inner corner, against the face's horizontal. A few degrees change the whole expression.

items.name: Eye opening (palpebral height)
items.look: How open the eyes are: upper lid margin to lower lid margin over the iris.

items.name: Eye shape (height / width)
items.look: Almond or round: the opening's height against its width.

items.name: Upper lid fold / hooding
items.look: How much lid shows between the lash line and the fold under the brow; hooded eyes show none. The clay render shows it as the shadow of the fold.
items.reliability: judge by eye: no landmark marks the fold

items.name: Brow height over the eye
items.look: Distance from the brow's lower edge above the pupil to the upper lid: low heavy brows or high open ones.
items.reliability: model brows are strokes drawn through its brow landmarks (paint isn't in clay)

items.name: Brow arch height
items.look: How much the brow's upper edge rises above the straight line from its head to its tail: flat or arched.
items.reliability: model brows are strokes drawn through its brow landmarks

items.name: Brow slant (head to tail)
items.look: Whether the brow tail sits higher or lower than the brow head: a falling tail reads sad or stern.
items.reliability: model brows are strokes drawn through its brow landmarks

items.name: Brow thickness
items.look: Height of the brow hair band above the pupil. This is paint (skin.brows), not shape.
items.reliability: judge on a painted look: clay brows are drawn strokes

items.name: Nose length (nasion to tip)
items.look: From the bridge between the eyes to the tip of the nose.

items.name: Nasal root width (between the eyes)
items.look: How broad the bridge is between the inner corners: a narrow pinched root or a broad flat one.
items.reliability: shading: the side wall's shade off the dorsal line against the dorsum's (likeness_shape), the photo against the model lit like it; a wider dorsum keeps the side wall lit further out. faceslide.nose_widths reads the same as mm

items.name: Nasal dorsum width (the middle of the nose)
items.look: How wide the bony / cartilage vault reads partway down, between the two dorsal lines of light and shade.
items.reliability: shading: the side wall's shade off the dorsal line against the dorsum's (likeness_shape), the photo against the model lit like it; a wider dorsum keeps the side wall lit further out. faceslide.nose_widths reads the same as mm

items.name: Nose width at the wings (alar)
items.look: Width across the nose's wings at their widest.

items.name: Alar width / intercanthal
items.look: The classical check: nose wings about as wide as the gap between the inner eye corners. Wider reads broad-nosed.

items.name: Nostril base width
items.look: Width across the nostrils where they meet the lip (the base, inside the wings): flare shows as wings much wider than this.

items.name: Tip above subnasale (front)
items.look: From the front: how far the tip hangs below or sits above where the nose meets the lip; a rotated-up tip shows the nostrils.

items.name: Nose projection (wing to tip)
items.look: In a three-quarter view: how far the tip stands out across the cheek from the wing. A profile gives the true projection.
items.control: fit_views (nose points; depth from a turned view)
items.reliability: profile item; inferred from a three-quarter view when there is no profile (tolerance x1.5)

items.name: Nasolabial angle
items.look: In profile, the angle between the columella (under the nose) and the upper lip: 90-95 degrees in men, more = an upturned tip.
items.control: base.head.regions (nose) by hand: no solver wired
items.reliability: profile item; inferred from a three-quarter view when there is no profile (tolerance x1.5)

items.name: Nose bridge profile (straight, hump, scoop)
items.look: The line of the bridge from nasion to tip seen from the side: straight, convex (a hump) or concave.
items.control: base.head.regions (nose) by hand: no solver wired
items.reliability: profile item; inferred from a three-quarter view when there is no profile (tolerance x1.5)

items.name: Nose tip projection (contour)
items.look: The nose's own edge: how far the tip stands out from the columella's base.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge against the far cheek (likeness_points line 'nose', by hand: +-1 px) against the extreme of the model's nose through the same camera; 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm of gap

items.name: Nose tip inside the far cheek's line (contour)
items.look: The gap between the nose's tip and the far cheek's contour at its height: a strong nose nearly reaches (or breaks) the line.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge against the far cheek (likeness_points line 'nose', by hand: +-1 px) against the extreme of the model's nose through the same camera; 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm of gap

items.name: Nose length nasion to tip (contour)
items.look: Down the face from the nasion to the tip's height on the nose's own edge.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge against the far cheek (likeness_points line 'nose', by hand: +-1 px) against the extreme of the model's nose through the same camera; 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm of gap

items.name: Bridge line: straight, hump or scoop (contour)
items.look: The nose's edge between the nasion and the tip against a straight line: + a hump, - a scoop.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge against the far cheek (likeness_points line 'nose', by hand: +-1 px) against the extreme of the model's nose through the same camera; 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm of gap

items.name: Nose base line (wing base to tip): rising or hanging
items.look: The line from the wing's base to the tip, against the face's horizontal: + it rises toward the tip, - the tip hangs below the wing (a beak). Read at once; a front view can't show it.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge in a turned view (likeness_points line 'nose') and the hand-placed near wing base (point 'alar_base.R' / '.L') against the model's nose contour and its alar landmark (lm 31 / 35) through the same camera; hand points +-1.5 px

items.name: Tip height against the wing's base
items.look: How far the tip stands above (+) or hangs below (-) the wing's base, down the face.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge in a turned view (likeness_points line 'nose') and the hand-placed near wing base (point 'alar_base.R' / '.L') against the model's nose contour and its alar landmark (lm 31 / 35) through the same camera; hand points +-1.5 px

items.name: Tip bluntness (radius on the contour)
items.look: The tip's roundness on the nose's own edge: a broad blunt tip (large radius) or a sharp one.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge in a turned view (likeness_points line 'nose') and the hand-placed near wing base (point 'alar_base.R' / '.L') against the model's nose contour and its alar landmark (lm 31 / 35) through the same camera; hand points +-1.5 px

items.name: Columella show (below the wing's base)
items.look: How far the columella's base hangs below the wing's base seen from the side.
items.reliability: the nose's own edge in a turned view (likeness_points line 'nose') and the hand-placed near wing base (point 'alar_base.R' / '.L') against the model's nose contour and its alar landmark (lm 31 / 35) through the same camera; hand points +-1.5 px

items.name: Columella show
items.look: In profile, how much of the strip between the nostrils shows below the wings (2-4 mm is usual).
items.reliability: profile needed

items.name: Mouth width
items.look: Corner to corner; in many faces the corners fall under the pupils' inner edges.

items.name: Mouth width / alar width
items.look: Mouth against nose: about 1.5 in adults.

items.name: Philtrum length
items.look: From under the nose to the top of the upper lip's red at the middle.

items.name: Upper lip height (vermilion)
items.look: Height of the upper lip's red at the middle: thin or full.

items.name: Lower lip height (vermilion)
items.look: Height of the lower lip's red at the middle.

items.name: Lower lip's visible width (cushion)
items.look: How far the lower lip's red runs toward the corners at half its middle height: a short central cushion (small) vs a lip out to the corners (large); over the mouth's width.
items.reliability: the detector's lip contour (photo and clay alike)

items.name: Lower lip's fullness (red area)
items.look: The lower lip's red area over the mouth's width squared: a pouting, everted lower lip shows more red.
items.reliability: the detector's lip contour (photo and clay alike)

items.name: Upper / lower lip
items.look: The two lips' balance: the lower lip is usually the fuller.

items.name: Cupid's bow width
items.look: Distance between the two peaks of the upper lip's outline.

items.name: Mouth-corner tilt
items.look: Whether the corners turn up or down from the line where the lips meet: a resting frown or smile.

items.name: Lips against the E-line (nose tip to chin)
items.look: From the side: the lips behind or on the line from the nose's tip to the chin.
items.reliability: profile item; inferred from a three-quarter view when there is no profile

items.name: Upper lip out of the mouth's notch (contour)
items.look: Where the lips break the contour: the upper lip's stand out of the notch between the lips.
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Lower lip out of the mouth's notch (contour)
items.look: Where the lips break the contour: the lower lip's stand out of the notch between the lips.
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Jaw angle height (gonion below the mouth line)
items.look: How high the jaw's angle sits: level with the mouth, or low near the chin line. A high angle reads lean and strong.
items.reliability: medium: the jaw contour is the detector's guess on both sides

items.name: Chin height (lower lip to chin bottom)
items.look: From the bottom of the lower lip's red to the bottom of the chin.

items.name: Chin shape (pointed, round, square, cleft)
items.look: The chin's outline from the front and its forward projection from the side.
items.reliability: judge by eye

items.name: Neck width under the jaw
items.look: Neck against jaw from the front: a thick neck fills the jaw's outline.
items.control: body (weight, muscle); neck_circ via fit_human free=body
items.reliability: judge by eye: no points under the jaw

items.name: Lines, folds and marks
items.look: Nasolabial folds, forehead and crow's-feet lines, scars, moles: FISWG's 'facial marks'. Folds are shape (shape.hollow, strokes); lines and marks are skin paint.
items.reliability: judge by eye on a painted look

items.name: Chin projection (lower lip to chin front)
items.look: From the side: how far the chin's front stands forward or back of the lower lip.
items.reliability: profile item; inferred from a three-quarter view when there is no profile

items.name: Chin projection (contour: chin corner against the brow)
items.look: The contour's corner where the face's front turns under the jaw, against the brow's peak: a strong chin stands out toward the brow's line, a weak one falls back.
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Chin depth below the mouth (contour)
items.look: From the mouth's height down to the contour's chin corner.
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Mentolabial fold depth (contour)
items.look: The hollow between the lower lip and the chin on the contour (0 = a straight run).
items.control: humanfit.fit_region chin_region + lower_lip_region on the contour
items.reliability: the far-side contour of a turned view (likeness_points line 'profile', snapped to the picture's edge) against the model's own silhouette through the same camera; mm in the picture (a turned view foreshortens depth); 1 deg of camera yaw is ~1 mm

items.name: Ear height and length
items.look: Top of the ear against the brow line, bottom against the nose base; the ear's length.
items.reliability: profile needed; the detector has no ear points

items.name: Ear protrusion
items.look: From the front, how far the ears stand out from the head's outline.
items.reliability: judge by eye: the detector has no ear points
